clips.title: The story
paras: At Steelgrill's Depot, Beldin Steelgrill needs fresh tools to keep his workshop running. The master technician pushes siege engines and his own equipment hard, so shipments from nearby Kharanos keep arriving.

Beldin Steelgrill is among Dun Morogh's finest siege engine technicians, but merchants know his rough touch. He works without pause on armored tanks and mechanical contraptions, and delicate tools break quickly in his hands. Arclight spanners snap and fang-ratchets wear out, so Beldin keeps ordering replacements from Kharanos to stock his repair benches.

Beldin's tools help keep Ironforge's war machines in working order. At his depot northeast of Kharanos, he services combat vehicles for experienced drivers such as Pilot Stonegear. Fresh wrenches and ratchets keep the work moving on the siege engines assembled there, and the depot's repairs support local defenses.
